workflow_instructions: This workspace reads live HubSpot CRM data. Resolve a company name before using its HubSpot record ID. Reuse complete fields already returned by tools. State unavailable fields plainly and never infer a primary contact, currency, renewal date, annual value, support mapping, owner, or missing record. OPEN deals are filtered using HubSpot's hs_is_closed property. Treat recommended actions as recommendations rather than CRM facts. Keep internal IDs out of normal prose and cite the HubSpot records used.
suggested_questions: Find the HubSpot company named Acme
Who are the contacts associated with Acme?
What open deals are associated with Acme?

workflow_prompts.label: Prepare a CRM meeting brief
workflow_prompts.message: Prepare a meeting brief for Acme using its HubSpot company details, associated contacts, and open deals. Clearly identify fields that are unavailable and cite the records used.

gpt-5.4-mini.basis: standard uncached input/output; estimate, not invoice
